content.text:
I checked every figure in the brief against the release (income statement, segment tables, OI&E table, cash flow statement and FCF reconciliation).

**Summary of what I found**

- The brief's stated figures are all accurate — revenues, operating income and margin, net income, EPS, segment revenues and losses, the capital raise, notes issuance, cash balances and the dividend all tie to the release.
- The problems are omissions, not errors: the brief never mentions **Google Cloud operating income** ($8,814M vs $2,826M — the profitability side of the headline 82% growth story), **negative free cash flow** of $(5,855)M in Q2 2026, or the fact that **no stock was repurchased** in the quarter (vs $(13,238)M a year ago), which makes the quarter's capital return dividends-only.
- On Other income, the brief gives the $97,983M net gain correctly but omits the release's disclosure that the equity-securities gain alone added **$6.26 to diluted EPS** — i.e. the bulk of the $9.11 GAAP EPS and the 294% increase is a non-operating, largely unrealized mark. The brief presents the 294% EPS growth in the Results section with no such qualifier, which is the most consequential gap for an IC reader.
- Related: the brief cites capex of $44,924M as a "watch item" but never connects it to the negative FCF it produced, and the balance-sheet section presents the $49.6B raise and $20.3B notes without noting that cash generation turned negative in the quarter.

One minor wording point: the release attributes Cloud growth to GCP enterprise AI Solutions and Infrastructure "as well as core GCP services"; the brief reverses the order. All the named drivers are in the release, so I scored it supported, but the emphasis is softened.

facts.evidence: Consolidated revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion, or 23% in constant currency (non-GAAP).
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112,107 million, and diluted EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24,768 million, led by core GCP services and an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Infrastructure and enterprise AI Solutions.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94,540 million, driven by growth in Google Search & other (17%), Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices (15%), and YouTube ads (13%).
Operating income increased 30% to $40,770 million, with operating margin expanding by 2 percentage points to 34%.
Other income reflected a net gain of $97,983 million, primarily due to net unrealized gains on equity securities.

In June 2026, the company raised $49.6 billion in aggregate net proceeds from the issuance of Class A, Class C, and mandatory convertible preferred stock for general corporate purposes, including scaling AI infrastructure and global compute.

claims.claim: Alphabet reported second quarter 2026 revenues of $119.8 billion.
Consolidated revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion.
Revenues increased 23% in constant currency, a non-GAAP measure.
Operating income increased 30% to $40,770 million.
Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112,107 million.
Diluted EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Other income reflected a net gain of $97,983 million, primarily due to net unrealized gains on equity securities.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94,540 million.
Google Services growth was driven by Google Search & other (17%), Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices (15%), and YouTube ads (13%).
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24,768 million.
Google Cloud growth was led by core GCP services and an increase in Google Cloud Platform across enterprise AI Infrastructure and enterprise AI Solutions.
Other Bets revenues were $382 million.
Other Bets had an operating loss of $1,799 million.
Alphabet-level activities primarily reflect expenses related to shared AI research and development.
Alphabet-level activities resulted in an operating loss of $5,789 million.
The release provides no guidance or outlook.
In June 2026, the company raised $49.6 billion in aggregate net proceeds from the issuance of Class A stock, Class C stock, and mandatory convertible preferred stock.
The June 2026 equity raise proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including scaling AI infrastructure and global compute.
The company issued senior unsecured notes in the second quarter of 2026 for net proceeds of $20.3 billion.
Total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $242,474 million as of June 30, 2026, compared to $126,843 million as of December 31, 2025.
In July 2026, the Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share on Class A, Class B, and Class C stock.
The release notes that fluctuations in the value of investments may significantly contribute to volatility of other income (expense), net in future periods.
The company entered into an agreement to sell up to $40.0 billion of Class A and Class C stock through an At-the-Market Program.
The company had not sold any shares under the ATM Program as of June 30, 2026.
The company spent $44,924 million on purchases of property and equipment during the quarter.
